panels.title: Мощность по каналам счётчиков сейчас (среднее за 10 с), кВт

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.name AS "Канал", avg(f.p) AS "кВт"
FROM power_fast f JOIN points p ON p.id = f.point
WHERE f.ts > now() - interval '10 seconds'
GROUP BY p.name, p.sort ORDER BY p.sort

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.ts, $__interval), p.name AS metric, avg(m.p_avg) AS value
FROM power_1m m JOIN points p ON p.id = m.point
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
GROUP BY 1, p.name ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS time, u1 AS "L1", u2 AS "L2", u3 AS "L3" FROM readings
WHERE point = 'M1.1' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS time, u1 AS "L1", u2 AS "L2", u3 AS "L3" FROM readings
WHERE point = 'M3' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.sort) p.name AS "Канал", r.ts AS "Время",
  round(r.i1::numeric,1) AS "I1, А", round(r.i2::numeric,1) AS "I2, А", round(r.i3::numeric,1) AS "I3, А",
  round(r.p1::numeric,2) AS "P1, кВт", round(r.p2::numeric,2) AS "P2, кВт", round(r.p3::numeric,2) AS "P3, кВт",
  round(r.pf::numeric,2) AS "cos φ",
  round(r.e_import::numeric,1) AS "Приём, кВт·ч", round(r.e_export::numeric,2) AS "Отдача, кВт·ч"
FROM readings r JOIN points p ON p.id = r.point
WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '1 day'
ORDER BY p.sort, r.ts DESC

panels.title: Рост энергии отдачи за сутки (должен быть 0; рост — ошибка подключения ТТ)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.name AS "Канал", round((max(r.e_export) - min(r.e_export))::numeric, 3) AS "Отдача за сутки, кВт·ч"
FROM readings r JOIN points p ON p.id = r.point
WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '1 day'
GROUP BY p.name, p.sort ORDER BY p.sort
SELECT ts AS "Время", point AS "Точка", error AS "Ошибка" FROM poll_errors ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
